property_summary: For any address newOwner and when called by the current owner, transferOwnership(newOwner) results in owner() equal to the provided newOwner; the mutant that assigns owner = msg.sender instead will make owner() equal to the caller (not newOwner) for inputs where newOwner != caller, so the rule is violated for those inputs.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to owner with assignment to msg.sender so transferOwnership sets owner = msg.sender (the caller) instead of the provided newOwner.
